summary: Staff and admins can edit the newsletter email as one default template plus optional per-newsletter versions, preview it with a real post, send a test and revert, while unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe stay locked.
detailed_changes: Added one default newsletter template, stored with versions on the v1.29.0 safe renderer. With nothing saved, the campaign email is byte for byte what it was before (#655).

Campaign emails render the subject, introduction, sign-off and button label through allowlisted {{ tag }} placeholders with escaping and sanitised Markdown. The layout, test banner, footer, unsubscribe and preferences links and List-Unsubscribe headers stay locked (#657).
The members-only and paid call-to-action wording added to gated posts is now editable; the defaults are unchanged (#658).
Each newsletter can have its own version that overrides the default; removing it returns to the default, and the newsletter list and edit pages show which template is in use (#656).
Staff → Newsletters → email template: a Markdown editor with a placeholder picker, a choice of sections (hero image, full post, excerpt) and unknown placeholders rejected on save (#659).

Preview the draft with a real published post shown as public, members or paid, and send a throttled test to yourself through the normal campaign test send. The post campaign test-send route is now throttled too (#660).
A post can choose which newsletter template its campaign uses; the campaign keeps the template it was created with, so later edits never change sent campaigns (#661).
Every save is a version with who and when; staff and admins can restore a version or revert, all audit-logged. Members and subscribers get 403 (#662).
Tests prove the unedited default is unchanged and that no template can remove or hide the unsubscribe link (#663).
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff and admins (editors); newsletter subscribers (receive the same email unless a template is saved)
Public impact: none until staff save a newsletter template
Internal impact: editable newsletter wording with preview, test send, version history and per-campaign template choice
